# v0.13

Released 2026-11-06.

## Highlights

- The bash/yad launcher is replaced by a Rust GTK4 launcher.
- pkgproxy becomes a workshop SDK, so apt and snap downloads are cached between builds.
- READMEs refreshed.

## Commits

- Update various READMEs (b411be3)
- Replace bash/yad launcher with a Rust GTK4 launcher (33dc421)
- Set up pkgproxy as a workshop SDK (ee61e9b)
